caption:
Your sale banner sets an expectation.

If only some products have the largest discount, make that clear. If customers need a code, say so near the offer. The headline and product page should tell the same story.

Price-history software does not write every sale message for you. India Prior Price records prices and can show the observed prior price when enough history and an eligible reduction exist.

Clear records and clear wording work together. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
